coverage_manifest: session-start-docker.ts — MOSTLY SOUND. Happy path ~0.5-1.5s (docker info + docker ps); async health-wait is well bounded (10s cap, 2 retries). One hazard: untimed execSync('docker info') can pin session open to the full 30s hook timeout when the engine is wedged (D2F-09).

session-register.ts — ISSUES. ~3-6s: two sequential `uv run python -c` Postgres round-trips at 3s cap each (D2F-06, D2F-04); registration silently no-ops at timeout while the awareness banner still claims coordination is active; COORDINATION_SESSION_ID env export is dead cross-process (file write is the real channel).

session-start-continuity.ts — WORST OFFENDER. ~5-6s typical on startup with a ROADMAP goal: inline spawnSync recall with 5s timeout < uv cold start burns 5s for nothing and can blow the hook's own 10s budget on clear/compact (D2F-02); contamination guard bypass via unguarded buildUnifiedContext duplicate extraction (D2F-03, seed SEED-02); duplicate ROADMAP Current Focus injection + triple ROADMAP read (D2F-10). Handoff-dir scanning itself is cheap (<100ms).

session-start-init-check.ts — ISSUE. Startup-only (good), but TREE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=300 makes the knowledge tree stale on virtually every startup, firing a <=10s uv-run regeneration nearly every session (D2F-05); stack-detection/skill scans are cheap (<100ms). Cross-project '.claude' path guard present.
session-start-recovery.ts — CLEAN. Pure-fs recovery scan + Ralph unified-state read, <0.2s incl. node startup; 24h self-cleanup; false-banner guard documented and present.

roadmap-reconcile.ts — BROKEN OUTPUT. ~0.3-0.5s/session (git log subprocess + fs), but emits nonstandard {values:{system}} so the contradiction report never reaches the model (D2F-01); milestone validation against only 10 commits is a latent false-positive generator once output is fixed (D2F-08).

session-start-context-loaders.ts — EXPENSIVE PROBE. ~3-7s: PowerShell startup + `uv run tree_daemon.py --status` every session even when daemon already runs; awaited with 15s internal / 20s hook timeout; invoked .ps1 exists only in ~/.claude, not the repo (D2F-07, seed SEED-15). Registered active-only.
session-start-memory-loaders.ts — EXPENSIVE PROBE. ~3-7s: same powershell+uv status pattern plus an unconditional 500ms sleep on daemon start (D2F-07). Registered active-only.
session-start-intel-prune.ts — CLEAN, FOLD CANDIDATE. Correct, fail-open, kill-switched; ~0.1-0.2s, dominated by node startup for <50ms of work (D2F-12).

hook-health-monitor.ts — MOSTLY CLEAN. ~0.3s settings parse + per-hook stat pairs; up to ~4s bounded network when tracing enabled (two 2s-capped fetches). spanId fallback to Claude session UUID likely orphans the hook_health_ratio feedback (D2F-11); registered active-only and without an explicit timeout.
notes: Latency budget context: active ~/.claude/settings.json registers 11 SessionStart commands (the 8 in the repo settings.json plus context-loaders/memory-loaders/hook-health-monitor — the delta is SEED-15). Per Claude Code docs hooks in an event run in parallel, so the session-open gate is the slowest hook, estimated 6-10s typical (continuity 5s recall burn / init-check tree regen / daemon probes), worst-case 30s (docker). If execution were serial the summed budget would be ~18-35s. The shared structural root cause is SEED-08's uv-run interpreter startup tax, paid >=5 times per session open (D2F-04). braintrust_hooks.py session_start was outside this dimension's assigned list and was not reviewed. All evidence quotes are from repo working-tree files at SHA 86b8f60 except the two daemon .ps1 scripts, which exist only in ~/.claude/hooks/ (their absence from the repo is itself part of finding D2F-07).
